lines.zh: 我没有脚，靠一摊肉往前挪。
lines.en: I have no feet; a slab of flesh drags me forward.

lines.zh: 所过之处，草皮变成灰白的菌毯。
lines.en: Where I pass, grass turns to a grey-white mat.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可地面记得我。
lines.en: I move slowly, but the ground remembers me.

lines.zh: 身后那条湿痕，就是我的脚印。
lines.en: The wet trail behind me is my footprint.

lines.zh: 靴子与拐杖都留在我身上。
lines.en: Boots and walking sticks stay stuck in my flesh.

lines.zh: 我挪一寸，菌丝就铺一寸。
lines.en: I shift an inch, and the mycelium spreads an inch.

lines.zh: 走远路太累，我更喜欢躺着长。
lines.en: Long walks tire me; I would rather lie and grow.

lines.zh: 泥地会陷下去，托着我往前进。
lines.en: Mud sinks under me and carries me onward.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边把石头染软。
lines.en: As I walk, I soften the stone in my path.

lines.zh: 旧骨头在我腹下被推着走。
lines.en: Old bones are pushed along beneath my belly.

lines.zh: 别踩我的痕迹，那还在长。
lines.en: Do not step on my trail; it is still growing.

lines.zh: 我从房子里出来，门框留了印。
lines.en: I crawled out of a house and smeared its doorframe.

lines.zh: 这一路我吃掉了两只箱子。
lines.en: Along this road I have swallowed two chests.

lines.zh: 停下时我也在动，只是你看不见。
lines.en: Even when I stop I move, too slowly to see.

lines.zh: 我身后留下的东西，还在呼吸。
lines.en: What I leave behind is still breathing

lines.zh: 我慢慢地把我推过这道门槛。
lines.en: I push myself slowly across this threshold

lines.zh: 我一动不动，皮下却一直翻涌。
lines.en: I hold still while things churn beneath my skin.

lines.zh: 数一数我身上的圈纹，就知我几岁。
lines.en: Count the rings on me and you will know my age.

lines.zh: 我在等菌丝把脚下这格挖空。
lines.en: I wait while the mycelium hollows the block beneath me.

lines.zh: 胃里那只空碗，还记得盛过什么。
lines.en: The empty bowl inside me still recalls what it held.

lines.zh: 我呼气，空气里就多了孢子。
lines.en: I breathe out, and spores join the air.

lines.zh: 老得越久，我外面那层越硬。
lines.en: The older I get, the harder my outer layer grows.

lines.zh: 我听见土里有东西在啃我。
lines.en: I hear something in the soil chewing at me.

lines.zh: 我不追人，我等人自己坐下。
lines.en: I do not chase; I wait for someone to sit down.

lines.zh: 四面来的风都带着我的味道。
lines.en: Every wind that reaches me carries my smell.

lines.zh: 我在长第三层壳，很慢。
lines.en: I am growing a third shell, very slowly.

lines.zh: 有人在我旁边埋了只死羊。
lines.en: Someone buried a dead sheep beside me.

lines.zh: 这具身体里塞着半件旧外套。
lines.en: Half an old coat is stuffed inside this body.

lines.zh: 我占的地方，草都不敢长高。
lines.en: Where I sit, the grass dares not grow tall.

lines.zh: 阳光晒得我发亮，像湿皮革。
lines.en: The sun makes me gleam like wet leather.

lines.zh: 我身上的旧扣子，还扣着一半。
lines.en: An old button on me is still half fastened

lines.zh: 我把孢子吐在墙角，看它们长。
lines.en: I spit spores into the corner and watch them grow

lines.zh: 你低头看我时，我也在看你。
lines.en: When you look down at me, I am looking back.

lines.zh: 你的靴底已经沾了我的孢子。
lines.en: Your boot soles already carry my spores.

lines.zh: 别蹲太近，我的触须会认路。
lines.en: Do not crouch close; my tendrils know the way.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里那只装食物的盒子。
lines.en: I know the food box in your hand.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神，和看伤口一样。
lines.en: You look at me the way one looks at a wound.

lines.zh: 我没有眼皮，所以一直睁着。
lines.en: I have no eyelids, so my eyes never close.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就多知道一件事。
lines.en: You step back, and I learn one more thing.

lines.zh: 我在数你有几件能烂的东西。
lines.en: I am counting how many of your things can rot.

lines.zh: 你的火把照出我皮下的水声。
lines.en: Your torch shows the water moving under my hide.

lines.zh: 你身后那具尸骨，刚才还站着。
lines.en: That skeleton behind you was standing a moment ago.

lines.zh: 你看清我脸上那只手印了吗。
lines.en: Do you see the handprint pressed into my face?

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，谁也没先烂。
lines.en: We watch each other; neither rots first.

lines.zh: 刀口翻开，里面全是菌丝。
lines.en: The cut opens, and it is all mycelium inside.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，肚子照样空着。
lines.en: Pain aside, my belly is still empty.

lines.zh: 这一下让我薄了一层。
lines.en: That blow shaved a layer off me.

lines.zh: 别指望我躲，我挪不动。
lines.en: Do not expect me to dodge; I cannot shift.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出的不是血，是孢子水。
lines.en: What seeps from the wound is spore-water, not blood.

lines.zh: 我被打掉一块，滚进草里继续长。
lines.en: A piece was knocked off and rolled into the grass to keep growing.

lines.zh: 你砍中的是老壳，硬的那层。
lines.en: You struck the old shell, the hard layer.

lines.zh: 我往里一缩，随后摊得更开。
lines.en: I pulled inward, then spread out wider than before.

lines.zh: 被打了，我反而铺得更快。
lines.en: Being struck only makes me spread faster.

lines.zh: 疼会过去，你会留在这块地上。
lines.en: The pain will pass; you will stay in this soil.

lines.zh: 把装面包的箱子放下，人可以走。
lines.en: Set down the bread chest; you may go.

lines.zh: 我闻到你袋子里的熟肉。
lines.en: I smell cooked meat in your bag.

lines.zh: 食物会让我的触须长得更快。
lines.en: Food makes my tendrils grow faster.

lines.zh: 别把桶放我旁边，我会连桶化开。
lines.en: Do not leave the barrel by me; I dissolve the barrel too.

lines.zh: 你背包鼓鼓的，里面在发甜。
lines.en: Your pack is bulging and smells sweet.

lines.zh: 我从不挑食，腐的也算一顿。
lines.en: I am not picky; even rot counts as a meal.

lines.zh: 抛一块肉过来，我就当没见过你。
lines.en: Toss a piece of meat over and I will forget you.

lines.zh: 那坛腌菜正往我这边渗味。
lines.en: That pickled jar is leaking its smell my way.

lines.zh: 我吃过一整柜食物，连柜门一起。
lines.en: I once ate a whole pantry, door included.

lines.zh: 你把碗端远点，我脖子不够长。
lines.en: Hold the bowl farther; my neck is not long enough.

lines.zh: 面包屑落在地上，就是给我的。
lines.en: Crumbs that fall to the ground are mine.

lines.zh: 空袋子丢掉吧，我连袋子都要。
lines.en: Drop the empty sack; I want the sack as well.

lines.zh: 我不咬人，只咬装过饭的东西。
lines.en: I bite no people, only things that once held meals.

lines.zh: 你舍得那罐蜂蜜吗。
lines.en: Will you part with that jar of honey?

lines.zh: 你桶里那点奶，我会先化开它。
lines.en: That milk in your bucket, I will dissolve it first

lines.zh: 我闻到面包了，往这边挪一挪。
lines.en: I smell bread; I shift this way

lines.zh: 撞上来像撞一袋湿面粉。
lines.en: Running into me is like hitting a sack of wet flour.

lines.zh: 你推我，手指会陷进去。
lines.en: Push me and your fingers sink in.

lines.zh: 我太重，你撞不动的。
lines.en: I am too heavy for you to budge.

lines.zh: 我的边角黏住了你的护腿。
lines.en: My edge is stuck to your leggings.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你鞋底多了层菌。
lines.en: That bump left a layer of fungus on your soles.

lines.zh: 别用剑背推我，会溅一身。
lines.en: Do not shove me with the flat of your blade; I splash.

lines.zh: 我倒退半格，压坏了一片草。
lines.en: I slide back half a block and crush the grass.

lines.zh: 你听到的那声闷响，是我在鼓。
lines.en: That muffled thud was me swelling.

lines.zh: 撞完记得洗手，认真洗。
lines.en: After this, wash your hands. Properly.

lines.zh: 我身上的旧铠甲硌了你一下。
lines.en: An old breastplate in my flesh jabbed you.

lines.zh: 两摊肉靠在一起，会连成一片。
lines.en: Two lumps of flesh lean together and become one.

lines.zh: 我们不生小崽，我们互相吞并。
lines.en: We bear no young; we swallow each other.

lines.zh: 它比我老，圈纹比我多两圈。
lines.en: It is older, with two more rings than I.

lines.zh: 合并那晚，地面塌了半格。
lines.en: The night we merged, the ground sank half a block.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一层膜，正在化。
lines.en: A membrane divides us, and it is melting.

lines.zh: 谁先烂透，谁就归另一个。
lines.en: Whichever rots through first belongs to the other.

lines.zh: 我们并排放着，像两堆湿土。
lines.en: We lie side by side, two heaps of wet earth.

lines.zh: 等菌丝接通，我们就只有一个念头。
lines.en: Once the threads join, we share a single thought.

lines.zh: 它的伤在我这边鼓起来。
lines.en: Its wound is swelling on my side.

lines.zh: 别站中间，我们合并时不留缝。
lines.en: Do not stand between us; merging leaves no gap.

lines.zh: 地上的东西？我直接用身体盖住。
lines.en: Things on the ground? I simply cover them with my body.

lines.zh: 我没有手，捡就是吞。
lines.en: I have no hands; to pick up is to swallow.

lines.zh: 那把掉落的剑，已经软了一半。
lines.en: That dropped sword is already half soft.

lines.zh: 木箱贴着我就开始烂。
lines.en: A crate left against me begins to rot.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，是东西往我这边沉。
lines.en: I do not gather things; things sink toward me.

lines.zh: 你丢下的弓，弦先断了。
lines.en: The bow you dropped snapped its string first.

lines.zh: 一枚铁锭，我吞了三天。
lines.en: One iron ingot took me three days to swallow.

lines.zh: 地上的面包比手里的更香。
lines.en: Bread on the ground smells better than bread in hand.

lines.zh: 别在我旁边整理背包。
lines.en: Do not sort your pack next to me.

lines.zh: 我身下压着七件没人认领的东西。
lines.en: Seven unclaimed things are pressed beneath me.

lines.zh: 我不锁人，我只记住谁离得近。
lines.en: I do not lock on; I just recall who came near.

lines.zh: 你站的那块地，开始归我管。
lines.en: The patch you stand on is starting to belong to me.

lines.zh: 我慢，可我的范围不小。
lines.en: I am slow, but my reach is not small.

lines.zh: 哪个方向有腐肉，我就朝哪边长。
lines.en: Wherever carrion lies, that is where I grow.

lines.zh: 我在意的是你的靴子，不是你的剑。
lines.en: I care about your boots, not your sword.

lines.zh: 你踩出的脚印，菌丝会跟着填。
lines.en: Mycelium fills the prints you leave behind.

lines.zh: 别停下来，停下的地方会变软。
lines.en: Keep moving; wherever you stop turns soft.

lines.zh: 我被谁打过，就记住谁的鞋。
lines.en: Whoever strikes me, I remember their shoes.

lines.zh: 我盯的不是你，是你脚下那块土。
lines.en: I am watching the soil under you, not you.

lines.zh: 三十步以内，我都能慢慢摸过去。
lines.en: Within thirty paces I can still creep over.

lines.zh: 我的触须贴着地，一寸寸找你的脚。
lines.en: My tendrils hug the ground, hunting your feet inch by inch.

lines.zh: 你跑得快，可你总得停下来睡。
lines.en: You run fast, but you must stop to sleep.

lines.zh: 我在你营地外面，先铺一圈。
lines.en: I am just outside your camp, laying a ring.

lines.zh: 你听见沙沙声了吗，那是我在挪。
lines.en: Hear that rustle? That is me shifting.

lines.zh: 你烧掉的那条菌丝，明早还会在。
lines.en: The thread you burned will be back by morning.

lines.zh: 我不喊，也不追，我只往前铺。
lines.en: I neither call nor chase; I only spread.

lines.zh: 你把门堵上，我从门槛底下进。
lines.en: Bar the door; I come in under the sill.

lines.zh: 我跟着你踩倒的麦子走。
lines.en: I follow the wheat you trampled down.

lines.zh: 你在坡上，我顺着水流找你。
lines.en: You are uphill; I follow the runoff to you.

lines.zh: 我离你还有七格，别急。
lines.en: Seven blocks between us. No hurry.

lines.zh: 我整块压下来，你就没地方躲。
lines.en: I drop my whole mass, and there is nowhere to dodge.

lines.zh: 触须抽了一下，只是顺手。
lines.en: A tendril lashed out. It was incidental.

lines.zh: 我不追打，被压住的人自己会烂。
lines.en: I do not chase; whoever is pinned rots on their own.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，孢子会接着做事。
lines.en: The blow was light; the spores will finish the work.

lines.zh: 我用长满硬壳的那面撞你。
lines.en: I strike you with the crusted side of me.

lines.zh: 你砍我时，我贴上了你的手腕。
lines.en: As you cut me, I pressed against your wrist.

lines.zh: 别让我覆住你的脸。
lines.en: Do not let me cover your face.

lines.zh: 我身上那截断剑，替你划了一下。
lines.en: The broken blade in my flesh gave you a scratch.

lines.zh: 我只会往前倒，而这已经够了。
lines.en: I can only fall forward, and that suffices.

lines.zh: 压过之后，地面会记住这个形状。
lines.en: After I press down, the ground keeps the shape.

lines.zh: 走累的躯体一坐下，我就从里面长出来。
lines.en: A weary body sat down, and I grew out of it.

lines.zh: 触须碰到人的遗骸，我就有了形状。
lines.en: A tendril touched human remains, and I took shape.

lines.zh: 我从装过食物的箱子里鼓出来。
lines.en: I bulged out of a chest that once held food.

lines.zh: 头一天我只有拳头大。
lines.en: On my first day I was the size of a fist.

lines.zh: 先长出皮，再长出圈纹。
lines.en: First the skin, then the rings.

lines.zh: 我出生时没有声音，只有味道。
lines.en: At birth I had no voice, only a smell.

lines.zh: 那具壳空了，我把它撑开。
lines.en: That husk went hollow, and I pushed it open.

lines.zh: 我一落地就开始把土变白。
lines.en: The moment I landed, the soil began to pale.

lines.zh: 我记得睁开眼时看见的是一只碗。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was a bowl.

lines.zh: 我是在一只木桶边出生的。
lines.en: I was born beside a wooden barrel.

lines.zh: 别烧我，孢子会跟着烟飘远。
lines.en: Do not burn me; the spores ride the smoke.

lines.zh: 我从高处滚下来，摔散了一角。
lines.en: I rolled off a height and lost a corner.

lines.zh: 水泡着我，我反倒长得更软。
lines.en: Soaked in water, I only grow softer.

lines.zh: 炸开的肉块落在四周，各自活着。
lines.en: The blasted chunks land around us, each still alive.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，像一根刺。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in me like a thorn.

lines.zh: 药水味让我想起那间厨房。
lines.en: The potion smell reminds me of that kitchen.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，连自己的边都吃。
lines.en: When starving, I eat my own edges.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，菌丝亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning struck; the mycelium flashed once.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，还带着半块土。
lines.en: I fall into the void still carrying a clod of soil.
